title: Pullback of the completed diagonal class before traces
statement: Let l be prime, let Y and Yprime be arbitrary schemes, and let g:Yprime→Y carry the three commutative BaseSquares of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-source-pullback]. Assume l is a unit on each base. Fix the localization data on both diagonal surfaces, derived reductions D and Dprime, and completed diagonal arrows satisfying IsDiagonalLimit [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-limit-characterization]. Fix CompletedRealization data eP,eW,ePprime,eWprime and ordinary supported-source isomorphisms s,sprime whose underlying sheaf maps have the source normalization of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Realize each completed arrow by s inverse, mapSingleArrow of the exact realization, and the shifted positive-line isomorphism. There exists SourcePullback data for the actual condensed Z_l coefficient, with the fixed spIntegralComparison maps on P and W, for which these two realized class arrows satisfy the delta square of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-pullback]. No trace data or other coefficient stages enter this assertion.

proof.text: Pull the positive Cartier extension by the units map and the inverse pulled-back equation. The diagonal equation a-b is regular over every base ring and its generator remains +1. Exact inverse image and canonical tensor pullback give a commuting square of entire Kummer systems, with ell in degree -1 and identity in degree zero in the quotient resolutions.

Closed base change and the explicit source and root limits make the normalized inverse-image/derived-limit maps invertible on both endpoints. Apply naturality to the single strict-system boundary. The whole-system characterizations identify the completed arrows. The source, unit, and root normalization equations transport the result to the specified condensed SourcePullback and delta square. No equality is detected by finite reductions of arbitrary derived maps.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: linear algebra trace_baseChange, exact derived functors and generic base-change lemmas. No completed cycle class or geometric trace compatibility theorem.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about linear traces or Weierstrass base change; none supplies a completed diagonal square or a normalized projective-line trace square.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No match. Loogle CategoryTheory.NatTrans.naturality provides only the general naturality equation.

mathlib_searches.results: Three Mathlib hits about stability of diagonal morphism properties under base change. Searches in both project roots found the canonical pullback structures and finite Cartier/P1 comparisons, but no whole-system completed compatibility theorem.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use finite Cartier/P1 results as dependencies; whole-system comparison remains to be proved.

theorem diagonalCompletedClass_pullback (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y Y' : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y')]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (geometry : BaseSquares g)
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hY' : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y', ⊤)))
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (D' : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y')))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (δ' : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y' ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y')
    (hdelta : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (hdelta' : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y' hY' D' δ')
    (eP : CompletedRealization l (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : CompletedRealization l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (eP' : CompletedRealization l (ProjectiveLine Y'))
    (eW' : CompletedRealization l (diagonalSurface Y'))
    (s : eW.F.obj (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅
      source (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y)
    (s' : eW'.F.obj (diagonalCompletedSource l Y') ≅
      source (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y')
    (hs : HEq (eW.underlying.inv.app (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≫ s.hom.hom)
      ((lowerStar Ab.{u + 1} (diagonalImmersion Y)).map
        (eP.underlying.inv.app (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.purTwistRing (ProjectiveLine Y)
            (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion (ProjectiveLine Y) l))) ≫ eP.unitIso.hom.hom)))
    (hs' : HEq (eW'.underlying.inv.app (diagonalCompletedSource l Y') ≫ s'.hom.hom)
      ((lowerStar Ab.{u + 1} (diagonalImmersion Y')).map
        (eP'.underlying.inv.app (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.purTwistRing (ProjectiveLine Y')
            (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion (ProjectiveLine Y') l))) ≫ eP'.unitIso.hom.hom))) :
    let R := Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]
    let δz := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).map s.inv ≫
      SpTowerClasses.mapSingleArrow eW.F (2 : ℤ) δ ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).map
          eW.lineIso.hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
    let δz' := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y')) 0).map s'.inv ≫
      SpTowerClasses.mapSingleArrow eW'.F (2 : ℤ) δ' ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y')) 0).map
          eW'.lineIso.hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
    ∃ data : SourcePullback R g (zlLine l)
        (spIntegralComparison (baseP g) l (bottomField l))
        (spIntegralComparison (baseW g) l (bottomField l)),
      (derivedUpper R (baseW g)).map δz ≫ data.endpoints.lineW.shift =
        (singlePullback R (baseW g) (source R Y)).hom ≫
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y')) 0).map
            data.supported.hom ≫ δz'
